My Musical Journey

Adith Vinu — Keyboardist

♪
🎹

Adith Vinu

Piano Instructor & Trinity College London Music Student

🏅 Trinity College London — Digital Keyboard - Level 1

I am Adith Vinu & I am an upcoming college student at the University of Texas at Dallas with over a decade of experience playing piano and exploring music technology.

I started learning the piano at age 6 and over time, I have performed at recitals, cultural events, attained certifications from Trinity College London for Digital Keyboard and I have composed music for short films.

Growing up, I had to navigate learning these instruments and technologies largely on my own, which is why I created AVMusic&Jam: to give students a more guided, engaging, and effective path to understanding music.

Every student learns differently, therefore, every lesson will be personalized to their pace, goals, and musical interests.

A Decade of Music

My Journey in Music

𝄞
🎹

Age 6 · The Beginning

First Piano Lesson

Sat at the piano for the first time and discovered a love for music that would shape the next decade and beyond. Started with basic scales and simple melodies.

Early Years · Building Foundations

Recitals & Cultural Events

Began performing at recitals and cultural events, gaining stage experience and learning how to connect emotionally with an audience through music.

🎤
🏅

Certification Achievement

Trinity College London — Digital Keyboard

Achieved an official certification from Trinity College London for Digital Keyboard, validating years of dedicated practice and technical mastery with formal accreditation.

Creative Expansion

Composing Music for Short Films

Ventured into music composition for short films — scoring original music that matched on-screen emotion, merging musical instinct with storytelling and technology.

🎬
💡

The Turning Point

Founding AVMusic&Jam

Recognized that many students face the same challenges I did — learning alone without guidance. Founded AVMusic&Jam to create the personalized, engaging learning experience I wish I'd had.

Present · 2025

University of Texas at Dallas

Heading to UTD as an incoming college student, continuing to teach students in Frisco, Prosper and surrounding areas while growing AVMusic&Jam.
